title: Private Half-Day San Diego Fishing Trip for up to 6 People
blurb: Enjoy a half day fishing along San Diego's beautiful coastline aboard a private charter! Captain Shaun, owner and operator of Pelican Sportfishing, will teach you what you need to know and assist as much or as little as you'd like. Our half day trips consist of fishing for a variety of species of rockfish, bass, lingcod and more. Captain Shaun is known for being personable, inviting and helpful, ensuring everyone has a great time aboard!
